title: Fats Waller needs a band and Greer takes Duke and others to New York
summary: Fats Waller asks Greer for five musicians; Greer recruits Duke, Otto, Whetsol and Snowden, boasts of knowing New York and the Clef Club.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: You know, so I go my way and have me some fun. I ain't paying anybody no mind. Because I'm way up on the hog, I'm making money. Pockets just laughing. And I wasn't married or nothing like that. I didn't know my wife existed then, anyway, Fats Waller came to town. I had been down there and I stayed down there about -- I had been down there about four years then. So Fats Waller came down there, to play Herdick & Seeman, burlesque house, he had them all over the country. Fats had a band played with the burlesque show, so one day Fats come up to the corner and he seen me, he knew me. He says, 'hey, Sonny, can you get me some musicians, I got to go to New York right away.' I said, 'man, you got me,' I'm tired of Washington then. You got me.
So anyway, he said I need five guys. I said I got them. I got Duke, I got Otto and boy called Arthur Whetsol played trumpet, call him 'Chief', and Elmer Snowden.
Yeah, come to New York. Duke say
